name: Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension / Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
proof: A positive recursive teaching plan is non-clashing: for two concepts, the one removed first has a positive teaching set that distinguishes it from the later concept, which was still present at that stage.  Thus its positive recursive plan is an admissible positive non-clashing mapping.
witness_verification: For C_{+triangle}={110,101,011}, positive RTD is 2 whereas positive NCTD is 1; sync/verify_positive_teaching_triangle.py exhausts the finite teaching-plan and teacher-map choices.
